entries.summary: Store lease and gate release failures preserve a refused ServiceInstallationError and its code, with the refusal and all release failures in its AggregateError cause; Hosts that matched the 0.42.0 AggregateError on first install must read cause instead. When a release fails and an upgrade, rollback or recover receipt remains pending, the new store_release_failed code directs the Host to recover; restart the Host process first if the stuck lease causes store_busy.
